FEAT-4-STORY-50.title: Implement Core NPI Registry Lookup Logic
FEAT-4-STORY-50.description: Build the core logic in provider_detail_service to query the CMS NPI Registry API using NPI or provider identifiers and parse the response into the standardized provider detail schema.

FEAT-4-STORY-51.title: Construct External Reference Links for Providers
FEAT-4-STORY-51.description: Enhance provider_detail_service to generate state medical board links and research-related URLs based on provider metadata (state, name, credentials).

FEAT-4-STORY-52.title: Implement Error Handling and Fallbacks for NPI API
FEAT-4-STORY-52.description: Add robust error handling for NPI Registry API failures including timeouts, empty results, and malformed responses, returning safe fallback outputs to the facade.

FEAT-4-STORY-53.title: Add Lightweight Response Caching for Provider Lookup
FEAT-4-STORY-53.description: Introduce a simple in-memory or request-scoped caching mechanism to avoid repeated NPI API calls for the same provider within a session.
FEAT-4-STORY-53.evidence: GAP: No explicit caching layer exists in provider_detail_service; lightweight caching inferred as needed for repeated API calls within session
